notes.title: Hexarium is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
We hope you're ready to design the roads as of TODAY! I'm absolutely thrilled by the excitement leading up to this moment, so I'll keep this short and sweet: HEXARIUM YOUR TRAFFIC MANAGEMENT GAME IS NOW AVAILABLE ON STEAM! 🎉

[list]
[*] 15 Levels 
[*] Brand new visuals
[*] Two biomes
[*] 3 modes
[*] Various buffs
[*] Increasing difficulty
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44620676/0fd2198d2af8eb84efee14b6a0c3e2fc5f09f011.gif[/img]

This is your chance to build and maintain a bustling road network in a minimalistic yet challenging environment. As demand increases and the pressure builds, how long can YOU keep the traffic flowing?

Let’s keep the city moving! 🚦
